Connection Matrix for Gespage Components
Key Documents for References:
Gespage Technical Prerequisites V9 - October 2023: Provides detailed technical setup information, including server requirements, network flows, and ports.
Gespage eTerminal Xerox Manual - December 2021: Describes the configuration and communication ports of Xerox eTerminals.
Gespage Server V9 User Manual - October 2023: Covers overall architecture, including server-to-agent communication and system setup.
Gespage Ports List: A specific document listing key port configurations.

Component | Port (TCP/UDP) | Direction | Purpose | Reference
Gespage Server | 7180 (TCP) | Incoming/Outgoing | General communication with agents, terminals, etc. | Gespage Technical Prerequisites V9 - Page 4
Gespage Server (Secure) | 7181 (TCP) | Incoming/Outgoing | Secure communication (HTTPS) | Gespage Technical Prerequisites V9 - Page 5
Global Print2Me | 7121 (TCP) | Outgoing | For secure printing with Global Print2Me | Gespage Technical Prerequisites V9 - Page 15
Print Submission | 80 (TCP) | Incoming/Outgoing | Standard HTTP print job submission | Gespage Technical Prerequisites V9 - Page 6
SMTP (Mail Server) | 25, 587 (TCP) | Outgoing | Sending email notifications | Gespage Technical Prerequisites V9 - Page 16
LDAP Directory | 389 (TCP), 636 (TCP, secured) | Outgoing | LDAP synchronization for user accounts | Gespage Technical Prerequisites V9 - Page 16
PostgreSQL Database | 5432 (TCP) | Outgoing | Communication with internal or external PostgreSQL database | Gespage Server V9 User Manual - Page 12
SNMP Monitoring | 161 (UDP) | Outgoing | SNMP for printer monitoring | Gespage Ports List - Page 1
eTerminal (Xerox) | 443 (TCP) | Incoming (from eTerminal) | Secure communication between Xerox eTerminals and Gespage server |

9 User Manual - Page 12
SNMP Monitoring | 161 (UDP) | Outgoing | SNMP for printer monitoring | Gespage Ports List - Page 1
eTerminal (Xerox) | 443 (TCP) | Incoming (from eTerminal) | Secure communication between Xerox eTerminals and Gespage server | Gespage eTerminal Xerox Manual - Page 8
Cartadis Card Reader | USB | Direct connection | Card reader for authentication on Xerox devices | Gespage eTerminal Xerox Manual - Page 30
Gespage Client (Popup) | 7180, 7181 (TCP) | Outgoing | Communication between client popups and Gespage server | Gespage Technical Prerequisites V9 - Page 16
Payment Stations | 7180, 7181 (TCP) | Outgoing | Communication with payment stations | Gespage Technical Prerequisites V9 - Page 16
